# October 13 upstream-path regression

The manifest records the exact two sync-managed source files changed from
cursor/plugins 1b6d44ff26d4e242f4e8f68c391e6d2f7ca16def to
1dcc2bacde73ddd284803b7af28164d0436198fc, and their fork counterparts at
LeonardSEO/pstack-for-codex cce049025b7ce971af50c5e9ed010aaf750f7e0d.

Hashes and modes are checked before installing each fixture. The tests build a
local upstream Git history and validate the complete plugin without network access.
The insertion asks delegates to use the parent's absolute skill path and asks the
parent to supply that path. Both instructions must survive the Codex adaptation.
